name: Falsification Sample
description: Selects experimental conditions most likely to falsify the current model by identifying regions where the model predictions may deviate from ground truth.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate for falsification potential.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Scikit-learn compatible model (regression or classification) to attempt to falsify.

parameters.name: reference_conditions
parameters.description: Experimental conditions that the model was trained on.

parameters.name: reference_observations
parameters.description: Observations that the model was trained to predict.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: VariableCollection with meta-data about the dependent and independent variables.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of high-falsification-potential samples to select.

parameters.name: training_epochs
parameters.description: Number of epochs to train the internal falsification network.

parameters.name: training_lr
parameters.description: Learning rate for training the falsification network.

parameters.name: plot
parameters.description: Whether to display network predictions and training loss visualization.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame or array of candidate experimental conditions.

inputDataType.name: model
inputDataType.description: Fitted model to attempt to falsify.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: DataFrame of conditions with highest falsification potential.
